title: Nonvanishing is equivalent to local generation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $s\in\Gamma(X,M)$. For every point $x\in X$, $s_x\notin\mathfrak m_x M_x$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] if and only if $s$ freely generates $M$ on an open neighbourhood of $x$ [def-sc-section-generating-locus].

source.place: Lemma 01CY, nonvanishing locus and local trivialization by a section

proof.text: Choose a local free generator e and write s=a e. The stalk basis identifies the germ of s with the germ of a and identifies the maximal-ideal submodule with the maximal ideal; hence nonvanishing is equivalent to a being a unit. The basic-open characterization of units gives the equivalence with local generation.
